component.name: Magic Pointer
component.summary: Ask Gemini about selected regions of your screen

description.p: Magic Pointer is a user-triggered visual assistant for Wayland desktops running Hyprland. Select a screen region, ask a question, and receive a streamed response in a native GTK chat window.

Captures and follow-up images are kept in memory by the application and sent to Google's Gemini API to generate responses. Users can annotate captures, attach additional regions during a conversation, and configure Gemini models, appearance, spatial context, and Hyprland window behavior.

ul.li: Screen region selection with window snapping and multi-monitor support
In-memory Wayland screen capture and image annotation
Streaming multimodal Gemini conversations with additional image attachments
GTK settings for API keys, model fallback order, appearance, and request timeouts
Hyprland-managed response window placement and styling
